methods.label: Choose a feasible survey scope
methods.explanation: There are extremely many secondary school students nationwide. A census would require substantial time and effort, so a sample survey is appropriate.
methods.levelReason: Choosing between a census and sampling from the population's size is a Grade 7 statistics concept.
